Team — putting together a short weekly ops pass on the forecast. Goal: close any outstanding stage ambiguity and surface true risks for today's revenue sync. Please read quickly and respond inline.

Attached: forecast_snapshot_20271108.csv

Top asks (15 min read):
1) Stage clarity: update the CRM row for each ACV opportunity to the exact stage token we use for submission (Demo, Eval, Negotiation, Legal, PO, Closed-Won). If there is a range, pick the conservative stage for commit math.
2) Commit flag: mark commit=true only if AE + customer procurement have pinpoints on PO timeline and dollar amount.
3) Risks: add one-line risk reason and mitigation. Use risk tiers: Green/Yellow/Red.
4) Attach any external blockers (security/compliance, legal redlines) to the deal record and mention here.

Acme (DEAL-ACME-2027-09) specifics: current CRM stage shows "Negotiation" but procurement indicated outstanding redlines on SOW and a questions list to engineering. I left an annotated SOW in Drive — see link. If we can't get procurement signoff by EOD Thursday, we should not include ACME in Friday's submission.

Sync: I'm proposing a quick 20-minute triage at 15:00 PST today to run the three top at-risk deals. If that works, I'll send an invite.

Irene
Irene Choi
